'''Ixzinian rock rams''' were beasts native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pellastrallas]] and the [[Ixzinia system/Legends|Ixzinia system]].<ref name="Planetnamia">{{JCFCite|url=posts/27848315|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2007-12-11|time=7:59 AM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20170916153037/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-43|quote=I wouldn't get your hopes up re alien homeworlds, beyond simple stuff like the Planetnamian species getting a Planetnamia on the map or things Dan and I can account for with a relatively quick reference.|archivefile=File:JasonFry-JCFAtlasHomeworlds.png}} [[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', stated his intention to create homeworlds for numerous species based on context implied from their names. Ixzinia appears to be one such case.</ref> They were grazing animals with an armored frill around their head and long, thick coat. They had black eyes and brown coat with white stripes along their backs. Some of them were prey of the [[arqet]], which hunted them in the planet's forests.<ref name= "CG" />

Many [[Beastmaster/Legends|beast masters]] hunted this animal for exotic animal collections and circuses.<ref name= "CG" />
